column1: # An armour set IS an outfit: the same class geometry repainted
# grants. Kept as one table rather than two systems
# "armour set" were the same record under different names.
# Exactly one non-shared set per class is the free starting outfit.
# sharedSet rows are purchasable Armoury choices
# tags   every row starts with item:armor; remaining tags are granted while worn
# artKey existing outfit id in this class whose complete artwork is reused
# artClassId selects another class's visual rig without changing gameplay class.
# inventoryArtKey selects a standalone item icon rather than the full-body pose.
